title: A short speech sample on a Graviton2 CPU endpoint
description: One bounded EDDIE trial generated one sentence with one preset voice. This is an example from a test installation, not a benchmark of your project.
model: NVIDIA Magpie TTS Multilingual 357M (v2607 F16 GGUF)

cleanup.scope: Endpoint, endpoint configuration, model, staged files and log group confirmed removed 304 seconds after removal was requested; checked again directly in AWS.

limitations: One request does not establish a percentile, throughput, concurrency or a longer input's completion time.
Synthesis took about 3.2 seconds per second of audio on this instance. It does not demonstrate live or streaming voice.
Peak memory covers one loaded model and codec with two generation and two codec threads; concurrent workers need their own measurement.
Speech quality was not evaluated. The audio was checked only for complete decoding in the recipe's format.
The cost is list price multiplied by the time from approval to confirmed removal (about 11 minutes); it is not an invoice.
